step_1_narrator.speaker: NARRATOR
step_1_narrator.dialogue: You step out into the courtyard behind the Whirling-in-Rags. The cold sea wind cuts immediately through your flare-cut trousers.

step_2_skillcheck.speaker: SHIVERS
step_2_skillcheck.dialogue: A shiver travels from the base of your spine up into your skull. Somewhere four blocks south, across the iced-over canal, a heavy iron crane swings in the dark.

step_3_npc.speaker: KIM KITSURAGI
step_3_npc.dialogue: "Are you alright, officer? You went completely rigid for a second there."

step_4_entity.speaker: HORRIFIC NECKTIE
step_4_entity.dialogue: 'Don't answer him, bratan! Keep your poker face! We're tapping into the frequency of the cosmos!'

step_5_conclusion.speaker: NARRATOR
step_5_conclusion.dialogue: You blink away the trance and nod at the Lieutenant. The city goes quiet again.
